forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.sub: Give us your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.successLine1: If an account with that email exists, we've sent you a link to recover the password.
forgot.successLine2: Check your inbox (and the spam folder, just in case).

reset.heading: Choose a new password.
reset.sub: Enter a secure password for your account.
reset.invalidLink: The link is invalid. Request a new one to recover your password.
reset.flashSuccess: Password updated. Sign in with the new one.
